recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for this issue; any future wording refinement for the retired extension should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or SDC extension source.
issue_request: FHIR-26990 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire change request to retire/deprecate the core questionnaire-referenceFilter extension because it duplicated the broader Structured Data Capture candidateExpression extension, and to reference the SDC extension instead.
initial_application: Core commit 75af8d8b69d1408d31b955ff12be114306c76b5f applied the issue by marking source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-referenceFilter.xml retired/deprecated and adding text that it had been replaced by the Structured Data Capture candidateExpression extension. Jira also records an SDC-side replacement commit comment outside the core checkout.
additional_context: FHIR SDC minutes from 2020-05-21 confirm the 8-0-0 approval and rationale. Later core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from R5 core source. Current core source has no active questionnaire-referenceFilter or candidateExpression hit outside source/oids.ini, while the current FHIR Extension Pack artifact is retired/deprecated and says it was replaced by Structured Data Capture candidateExpression.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing core source would be inappropriate because the active extension definition is no longer in the core build, the retained OID entry is legitimate registry data, and the maintained Extension Pack artifact already carries the approved deprecation and replacement guidance.
